title: 第二十一章 堪破真身易筋圆满第二十二章 洗髓大成玉蟾翻浪功
content_zh:
晦涩难懂的发音，明显不是人声。
吴青也没有见过这两个黑袍身影的真正面目，但却猜到了他们身份。
与这传说中的赶尸人做交易，吴青也是迫不得已为之。
被这么多捕快、捕役搜寻追赶，他又不会飞天遁地，岂能摆脱追踪？
县衙的这些捕快可不是吃干饭的，论及武道也许不如吴青，但在其他方面.....很是有一批好手。
再次朝着地上少年一躬身，吴青捡起粽叶斗笠，随手往头上一扣，往四方八面看了一眼，低头朝着一个方向疾步走去。
三十丈外的一个小山头，铁棠、段景瑞、比岐趴在地上，冷眼看着远处发生的一幕。
当看到吴青显出真容，比岐忍不住拍手击赞。
“棠哥儿，你是怎么猜到的？”
便是段景瑞，也心悦诚服地看了铁棠一眼。
“神捕之名，总捕头当之无愧。”
铁棠没有自得，只是淡淡说道：“我是觉得，修为炼到吴青那等境界，伸筋拔骨应当并非难事。
何况还有那等邪魅诡异的赶尸人存在，若是有他出手相助，瞒过我们也是等闲。
其实我也没有十足把握，纯粹是.....直觉。”
眼见吴青离开，三人纷纷起身，在他们身后还有三列四人小队，都是修为较高的捕快。
“总捕头神算，我等.........”
后半段刑堂堂主等捕快的恭维，称赞......铁棠那是半点都听不到了。
就在刚刚，面板突然轻微震动了三下。
这股动静很小，但铁棠却捕捉到了。
星元+1！

星元+1！
星元+1！
连续三次+1，让如今铁棠的星元数量，再次达到了3点。
怎么回事？
怎么突然就涨了？
是我堪破了吴青的伪装，还是......
铁棠有了想法，他回过神来，朝着比岐招了招手。
“小岐，你多夸我几句。”
“啊？”比岐一脸纳闷。
“像他们一样，夸我几句。”
比岐不明白铁棠在想什么，印象中这位可不是好大喜功之人，不过此事的确多亏了铁棠，夸赞起来也没压力。
“棠哥儿，你是这个！”比岐比了个大拇指。
“能不能来点好听点的？”
“我的水平您知道，肚子里哪有多少墨水？”
铁棠等了片刻，星元并没有增加，让他微微失望。
不是么？
到底要如何才能增长？
一时半会没有搞明白，而此时吴青已经快要走远了。
“总捕头，需得出发了。”
铁棠扫了一眼众人，按下手掌。

“人多容易惊动他，此行由我、段县捕、林堂主三人前去追寻，尔等坠在我等后头，切记不可轻举妄动。”
段景瑞疑惑道：“总捕头的意思是.....还想看看吴青身后是否有别人？”
content_en:
The obscure pronunciation is obviously not a human voice.
Wu Qing had never seen the true faces of these two black-robed figures, but he guessed their identities.
Wu Qing had no choice but to make a deal with this legendary corpse exorcist.
Being searched and chased by so many policemen and agents, and he couldn't fly and escape, how could he escape the pursuit?
These county government agents are not just for free. They may not be as good as Wu Qing when it comes to martial arts, but in other aspects... they are quite good at it.
Bowing to the boy on the ground again, Wu Qing picked up the rice dumpling leaf bamboo hat, clasped it on his head, glanced in all directions, lowered his head and walked quickly in one direction.
On a hilltop thirty feet away, Tie Tang, Duan Jingrui, and Bi Qi were lying on the ground, watching the scene happening in the distance with cold eyes.
When he saw Wu Qing showing his true appearance, Bi Qi couldn't help but clap his hands and praise him.
"Brother Tang, how did you guess that?"
Even Duan Jingrui looked at Tie Tang with sincerity.
"The chief catcher is well-deserved for his reputation as a divine catcher."
Tie Tang was not complacent, but simply said: "I think it shouldn't be difficult to stretch your muscles and pull out your bones if you reach the level of Wu Qing.
What's more, there are those evil and strange corpse exterminators. If he helps, it will be easy to hide it from us.
Actually, I'm not completely sure, it's just... intuition. "
Seeing Wu Qing leave, the three of them stood up one after another. Behind them were three teams of four, all of whom were high-level catchers.
"The always scheming person, I'll wait..."
In the second half of the sentence, the compliments and praises given by the head of the execution hall and other detectives... Tie Tang couldn't hear any of them.
Just now, the panel suddenly vibrated slightly three times.
The movement was very small, but Tie Tang caught it.
Star Yuan +1!
Star Yuan +1!
Star Yuan +1!
With three consecutive +1's, Tie Tang's star count reached 3 points again.
What's going on?
Why did it suddenly rise?
Was it me who broke Wu Qing's disguise, or...
Tie Tang had an idea. He came to his senses and waved to Biqi.
"Xiao Qi, please praise me more."
"Ah?" Biqi looked puzzled.
"Like them, give me a few compliments."
Bi Qi didn't understand what Tie Tang was thinking. He had the impression that this person was not a person who was overjoyed with success, but it was indeed thanks to Tie Tang that he felt no pressure to praise him.
"Brother Tang, you are this one!" Bi Qi gave a thumbs up.
"Can I have something nicer?"
"You know my level, but how much ink is there in my stomach?"
Tie Tang waited for a moment, but the Xing Yuan did not increase, which made him slightly disappointed.
Isn't it?
How exactly can we grow?
I didn't understand it for a while, but at this time Wu Qing was almost gone.
"The chief arrester needs to go."
Tie Tang glanced at everyone and pressed his palms.
"It's easy to alert him if there are many people. I, Duan Xianzhao, and Hall Master Lin are going to pursue him this time. If you fall behind us, remember not to act rashly."
Duan Jingrui asked in confusion: "What the chief arrester means is...you want to see if there is anyone else behind Wu Qing?"
